zh: 昨晚八点我正在做饭，突然有人敲门。
old_en: Last night at eight, I was cooking when someone knocked on the door.
new_en: Last night at eight, I was cooking when someone knocked on the door.

zh: 昨晚八点我在厨房做饭时，门铃突然响了。
old_en: Last night at eight, I was cooking in the kitchen when the doorbell suddenly rang.
new_en: Last night at eight, I was cooking in the kitchen when the doorbell suddenly rang.

zh: 上周六我在等公交的时候，突然下起了大雨。
old_en: Last Saturday, I was waiting for the bus when it suddenly started raining heavily.
new_en: Last Saturday, I was waiting for the bus when it suddenly started raining.

zh: 昨晚十点我正在洗澡，突然停电了。
old_en: Last night at ten, I was taking a bath when the power suddenly went out.
new_en: Last night at ten, I was taking a bath when the power went out.

zh: 前天晚上我看电视时，邻居来借一把椅子。
old_en: The night before, I was watching TV when a neighbor came to borrow a chair.
new_en: The night before, I was watching TV when a neighbor came to borrow a chair.

zh: 前天晚上我正在看电视，邻居敲门来借工具。
old_en: The night before, I was watching TV when a colleague knocked on the door to borrow some tools.
new_en: The night before, I was watching TV when a neighbor knocked to borrow some tools.

zh: 昨天中午我正在吃饭，同事突然打来电话。
old_en: Yesterday at noon, I was having lunch when a colleague called to ask about my afternoon plans.
new_en: Yesterday at noon, I was having lunch when a colleague called.

zh: 上周日我逛超市时，正好遇到一个老朋友。
old_en: Last Sunday, I was shopping in the supermarket when I met an old friend.
new_en: Last Sunday, I was shopping at the supermarket when I ran into an old friend.

zh: 上周日我在超市买东西时，朋友叫住了我。
old_en: Last Sunday, I was buying things in the supermarket when my friend called me over.
new_en: Last Sunday, I was shopping at the supermarket when my friend waved me over.

zh: 昨晚我写报告时，孩子突然哭了起来。
old_en: Last night, I was writing a report when the baby suddenly started crying.
new_en: Last night, I was writing a report when my child started crying.

zh: 前天下午我在公园跑步时，突然下起了雨。
old_en: The day before, I was running in the park when it suddenly started raining.
new_en: The day before yesterday, I was running in the park when it suddenly started raining.

zh: 今天早上我做早饭时，烤箱突然响了。
old_en: Today morning, I was cooking breakfast when the oven started making noise.
new_en: This morning, I was making breakfast when the oven started beeping.

zh: 昨天下午开会时，我的手机突然响了。
old_en: When I was speaking, my phone was ringing.
new_en: When I was in a meeting yesterday afternoon, my phone suddenly rang.

zh: 昨天下午我正在开会，手机响了两次。
old_en: Yesterday afternoon, I was having a meeting when my phone rang twice.
new_en: Yesterday afternoon, I was in a meeting when my phone rang twice.

zh: 上周六下雨时，我正在公交站等车。
old_en: When it was raining last Saturday, I was waiting at the bus stop.
new_en: Last Saturday when it was raining, I was waiting at the bus stop.

zh: 昨晚十点我在洗澡时，灯一下子全灭了。
old_en: Last night at ten, I was showering when the lights suddenly went out.
new_en: Last night at ten, I was taking a shower when the lights suddenly went out.

zh: 昨天中午吃饭时，同事打电话问我下午的安排。
old_en: Yesterday at lunch, my colleague called while I was asking about my afternoon plans.
new_en: Yesterday at lunch, my colleague called to ask about my afternoon plans.

zh: 今天早上我正在烤面包，烤箱响了一声就停了。
old_en: Today morning, I was toasting bread when the oven beeped and stopped.
new_en: This morning, I was toasting bread when the oven beeped and stopped.

zh: 前天下午我沿着河边跑步，突然下起了大雨。
old_en: I was running by the riverbank when it suddenly started raining heavily.
new_en: I was running by the river when it suddenly started raining hard.

zh: 昨晚写报告的时候，孩子醒了，我只好先去哄他。
old_en: Last night while I was writing the report, my child woke up, so I went to comfort him.
new_en: Last night while I was writing the report, my child woke up, so I went to comfort him.
